name: U Never Sleep
tagline: Auto-responds to matching Upwork jobs with AI-written proposals within minutes.
description: U Never Sleep filters Upwork job postings against your budget, keyword, and client-history criteria, then generates and submits a personalized proposal within minutes of a job going live. It tracks proposals, open rates, and responses in a dashboard and ships a free Chrome extension that scores your Upwork profile.
edge: Auto-submits AI-written Upwork proposals within minutes via the official API, billed per response — a niche no general outreach tool covers.
pros: Billed per response, not per seat
